scope: Shared H/F loci only. Global numbered-folio split by sha256(v65:folio), alternating train/test, same for both readings and every stratum. Hand, Currier, section and raw format separate. Earlier analyses saw corpus: retrospective validation, not untouched discovery.
model: Add-half character-bigram language model with word-start and word-end boundaries. Mean negative log probability per transition. EVA characters are transcription symbols, not phonemes or indivisible manuscript glyphs. Unknown tokens excluded, barriers preserved. Train each stratum separately; >=3 training folios and >=200 readable tokens.
ranking: Held-out types scored under frozen model. Within each stratum compare only distinct held-out types of EXACT same EVA length and EXACT training word count (zero includes unseen types). >=5 other types needed for percentile. Top10 by matched percentile then surprise for display only; all tokens/types including unsupported retained. Percentiles are exploratory, not p values.
test: Predeclared first-source-token versus interior-source-token anomaly comparison within each held-out numbered folio and exact length/training-frequency cell. Exclude final/single/unknown anchors. Average matched cell differences equally within folio; >=5 matched folios per stratum. One-sided folio sign-flip999, Bonferroni all eligible H/F panels. Descriptive cell weighting; sign symmetry is an assumption. No cross-format test or paragraph-start inference. Exact repeat word types may appear in both folds; training frequency controlled, not type-disjoint.
qualification: Before manuscript scoring, fixed synthetic templatic language with held-out typical and unusual strings; score must rank all unusual over typical. This is engineering qualification only, not calibrated realism or semantic validation.
exceptions: Retain all scores, missing coverage, unseen forms, unrankable types, joined/split H/F line alternatives and non-significant panels. No phonetic assumption, no adapted thresholds after test results.
